heading: Journal on this device
intro: Sets saved here stay on this device, even offline and after closing. Use sample data: there is no account yet.
unavailable: This browser does not allow the journal to be saved. Leave private browsing or allow site data, then reload.
newerFormat: The journal was saved by a newer version of the app. Update the app before recording more sets.
inputError: Check the values: load from 0 to 1000 kg, whole repetitions from 1, whole RIR from 0 to 10 or empty.
saveError: The set was not saved. Try again: it will not be duplicated.
editError: The change was not saved. Try again: it will not be applied twice.
missingSet: This set is no longer in the journal. Reload the page.
conflict: Another tab changed this set in the meantime. The journal keeps the saved value until you choose.
